content.text: I fixed the bug in `solution/util.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). In `_find_cycle`, the DFS found a back-edge to a node `v` on the stack. It then returned `stack[i + 1:]`, which left out `v`, the node that starts the cycle. The reported cycle was therefore missing its first node, so the closing edge `(cyc[-1], cyc[0])` wasn't a real edge. A self-loop `a→a` gave an empty list. I changed the slice to `stack[i:]`.
